channel.title: Violations Watch: Palestine (West Bank)
channel.description: New incidents reported in Palestine (West Bank). Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Israeli soldiers detain Palestinian farmers and foreign peace activists, including a US peace advocate, and force them off their land north of Hebron (Killeen Daily Herald, WAFA)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Hebron, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Persecution & repression. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces. Disputed or caveats: WAFA is the Palestinian Authority news agency. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2536

item.title: Israeli settlers smash the foundations of a Palestinian family's homes in Jaloud, West Bank (Reuters)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Jaloud, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Destruction of property. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli settlers. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2389

item.title: Israeli military court orders six months' administrative detention without charge for Palestinian journalist Samer Khweira, arrested at his Nablus home on 2 Nov after he spoke to Haaretz about prison abuse (The New Arab, Haaretz)
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Nablus, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Attacks on journalists, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli authorities. Disputed or caveats: Prosecutors questioned him on suspicion of incitement over an interview with Haaretz. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2390

item.title: CPJ condemns a new wave of arrests and extended detentions of Palestinian journalists by Israeli authorities, including a six-month detention order for journalist Samer Khweira
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Palestine (West Bank). Types: Attacks on journalists, Arbitrary detention & disappearance. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli authorities. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1944

item.title: A Palestinian is killed and another wounded when a guard from an Israeli settlement opens fire near Dura, Hebron, on 20 Nov
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Dura, Hebron, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli settlement guard. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 1 injured. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-1410

item.title: Palestinian woman (reported as 60 or 72) shot dead in Jericho, West Bank, overnight 16–17 Nov; Palestinian officials and Reuters attribute it to Israeli settlers, 4–10 wounded; IDF probe suggests the gunfire was aimed at stone-throwers
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Jericho, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli settlers (per Palestinian officials and Reuters); IDF investigating. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 4-10 injured. Disputed or caveats: Victim's age given as 60 or 72; wounded 4 to 10; IDF says gunfire likely aimed at stone-throwers and reports three Israelis injured; includes X account, not verified. 8 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0923

item.title: Israeli forces arrest Palestinian journalist Mohammad Ateeq, an AFP contributor, after raiding his home in Burqin, west of Jenin, and hold him without charge over alleged Hamas ties (CPJ); two brothers also detained in Nablus
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Burqin, Jenin, Palestine (West Bank). Types: Arbitrary detention & disappearance, Attacks on journalists. Alleged perpetrator: Israeli forces. 2 sources. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-0751
